topNews.title: NVIDIA Pauses $100B Investment in OpenAI — 'Will Join New Round at Record Scale'
topNews.summary: NVIDIA has temporarily paused its massive investment of approximately $100 billion in OpenAI. However, CEO Jensen Huang stated that NVIDIA will participate in OpenAI's new investment round at a record-breaking scale. This demonstrates NVIDIA's continued commitment to expanding its strategic influence within the AI ecosystem.
topNews.reason: NVIDIA's strategic investment, as the leading AI chip company, has a pivotal impact on the direction and growth of the entire AI industry.

topNews.title: 60% of Global AI Investment Flows to Silicon Valley — OpenAI & Anthropic Raise $58.5B
topNews.summary: Global AI investment nearly doubled last year, with 60% concentrated in Silicon Valley. Leading AI companies such as OpenAI and Anthropic are driving growth by securing massive funding rounds. This highlights the explosive expansion of the AI industry and the strong concentration of capital around core technology companies.
topNews.reason: Understanding the flow of AI investment, key hubs, and leading companies is critical for identifying related investment opportunities.

topNews.title: Korean Retail Investors Keep Buying US Stocks Despite Weak Won — Holdings Up $11B
topNews.summary: Despite rising USD/KRW exchange rates, Korean individual investors continued to grow their US stock investments. By year-end, their US equity holdings increased by over 16 trillion won (approx. $11B), reaching a record high. This reflects sustained confidence and a strong preference among investors for global markets, particularly US equities.
topNews.reason: Tracking retail investor sentiment and capital flows helps gauge market stability and assess whether the US equity bull run is likely to continue.

analysis.marketSentiment: Strong growth expectations in the AI sector and robust investor sentiment toward US equities continue to have a positive impact on the overall market.
